reason: A settings and integration plugin for managing connected Roblox Studio MCP instances, selecting the active instance, exposing that selection to agents, and displaying official script-sync status.

summaries.zh: 用于管理已连接的 Roblox Studio MCP 实例、选择活动实例、向智能体提供运行时上下文并显示官方脚本同步状态的设置与集成插件。
summaries.en: A settings and integration plugin for managing connected Roblox Studio MCP instances, selecting an active instance, providing runtime context to agents, and displaying official script-sync status.

capabilities: Lists connected Roblox Studio MCP instances
Activates or clears the selected Studio instance
Injects the selected studio_id into agent runtime context
Persists Roblox Studio connection and script-sync settings
Queries official script-sync status through MCP
